metadata.title: Jeremy Ruckert catches two passes in Week 2
metadata.description: Jeremy Ruckert caught both of his targets for five yards in the Jets' 20-17 loss to the Green Bay Packers in Week 2.
metadata.analysis: Ruckert has seen minimal involvement in the New York passing attack to begin the season, seeing two targets or less in each of the first two contests. The tight end remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a favorable Week 3 contest against the Detroit Lions.

metadata.title: Jeremy Ruckert - Stays on the field in win
metadata.description: Ruckert played 29 offensive snaps, catching his sole target for four yards in Sunday's 23-10 win over the Titans.
metadata.analysis: Ruckert played 43 percent of the offensive snaps for the Jets, showing the team's inclination towards 13-personnel. Despite being the No. 3 tight end, Ruckert seems to be regularly involved in the offense as both a blocker and route runner.

metadata.title: Jeremy Ruckert - First NFL TD among 23 catches
metadata.description: Ruckert caught 23 of 29 targets for 179 yards and one touchdown while playing in all 17 games in 2025.
metadata.analysis: Ruckert set career highs in catches, receiving yards and targets in his fourth NFL season, and the 2022 third-round draft pick scored his first NFL touchdown in Week 2 against the Bills. After signing a two-year, $10 million contract extension with his hometown team in December, the Lindenhurst, NY native is poised to retain the second spot on the Jets' tight end depth chart behind 2025 second-round pick Mason Taylor (neck) in 2026.

metadata.title: Jeremy Ruckert - One catch in Week 17
metadata.description: Ruckert caught one of three targets for two yards in Sunday's 42-10 loss to the Patriots.
metadata.analysis: In the ongoing absence of Mason Taylor (neck), Ruckert has ceded most of the pass-catching opportunities to Stone Smartt. Ruckert has three catches for 16 yards on six targets over the past two games, while Smartt has caught seven of eight targets for 52 yards in that span. Heading into the regular-season finale against the Bills, Ruckert has exceeded two catches only twice this season.

metadata.title: Jeremy Ruckert catches two passes in Week 16
metadata.description: Jeremy Ruckert caught two of his three targets for 14 yards in the Jets' 29-6 loss to the Saints in Week 16.
metadata.analysis: Ruckert remains minimally involved in the New York offense, registering three targets or less in each of his last five games. The tight end cannot be trusted in any format ahead of a difficult Week 17 contest against the New England Patriots.

metadata.title: Jeremy Ruckert - Inks extension with Gang Green
metadata.description: Ruckert signed a two-year, $10 million extension with the Jets on Wednesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
metadata.analysis: The fourth-year pro from Ohio State has agreed to a new deal that keeps him with the Jets through the 2027 season. Ruckert has played a reserve role for most of his NFL career, catching 55 of 75 targets for 427 receiving yards and one touchdowns across 55 games. His role in the Jets' offense could grow following Wednesday's extension, though he's still expected to remain the top back up to Mason Taylor.

metadata.title: Jeremy Ruckert inks extension with Jets
metadata.description: Jeremy Ruckert has come to terms on a two-year contract extension with the Jets.
metadata.analysis: Originally drafted in the third round back in 2022 by the Jets, Ruckert will be continue donning the green and white for at least another couple of years. The 25-year-old TE has caught 20 passes for 163 yards and one score across 14 games so far this season.

metadata.title: Jets, Jeremy Ruckert Agree to a Two-Year Extension
metadata.description: NFL Insider Ian Rapoport reported on Wednesday morning that the New York Jets have agreed to terms with young tight end Jeremy Ruckert, locking him in for the future. He gets a 2-year, $10M extension with upside to $11M. Ruckert, the fourth-year player out of Ohio State, has underwhelmed in the receiving game since joining the Jets. This year, he has hit career highs in receptions (20) and receiving yards (163), but was drafted in the third round and is an asset to the team primarily because of his willingness and effectiveness to block in the run game. The Jets now have Ruckert and a rookie out of LSU, Mason Taylor, as their top tight end options for years to come. From a fantasy football standpoint, Ruckert is well off the radar and shouldn't be rostered in any formats.

metadata.title: Jeremy Ruckert - Catches two passes vs. Jacksonville
metadata.description: Ruckert caught both of his targets for 13 yards in Sunday's 48-20 loss to the Jaguars.
metadata.analysis: The Ohio State product recorded the fifth-most receiving yards on the Jets while filling in for the injured Mason Taylor (neck) during Sunday's loss. Ruckert has now caught 20 of 23 targets for 163 yards and one touchdown across 14 appearances this season. He's expected to return to a reserve role if Taylor is active for the Week 16 matchup against the Saints.

metadata.title: Jeremy Ruckert finishes with two receptions in Week 15
metadata.description: Jeremy Ruckert caught both of his targets for 13 yards in Sunday's loss to the Jaguars.
metadata.analysis: Ruckert has caught two passes in three straight weeks, as he remains just a small part of the Jets' passing game. He can be left on waiver wires.
